These lashes are absolutely worth it for the price! They were long, dramatic, soft, and so pretty. What I didn’t expect was how comfortable these are. They were so soft and lightweight on my eyes. The sides of the lashes didn’t irritate my eyelids at all, unlike other brands I’ve tried. I did notice that not all the lashes are exactly identical, but the difference is not that noticeable once you’re wearing them. I’ve gotten a lot of compliments on them and would definitely buy again!

For 8$ and several pairs of lashes, it’s a good value. However, I’m new at using lashes and wanted something that’s a bit easier to apply, they also didn’t flatter my eye shape but that’s on me.I found the band a little harder to work with than other lashes I’ve used. I’ve used DYSILK lashes before and for the value they’re easier to use and more flattering.

reviews.t: Perfect look for that natural glam
reviews.x: I do cut the ends of these to fit the shape of my eye. If you have larger eyes and or almond shaped eyes these won’t appear as dramatic on you.  Find these useful for every day glam. I get about 4 to 5 uses out of each pair. Just make sure that you are cleaning the glue off after every use and storing them correctly.

besides the adhesion everything else was great, very lightweight, pretty, i did need to trim them a bit because they were long for me. the adhesion did not stay on my lid one bit, be sure you have some lash glue on hand.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes pretty, well-made, and worth the price.
Several reviewers describe the lashes as dramatic or voluminous, which some love for nights out but others find too much for everyday wear.
Some reviewers report inconsistency between the two lashes in a pair, such as uneven hair amount or one being more dramatic than the other.
A few reviewers mention application or adhesion issues, including the band being harder to work with and lashes not sticking well to the eyelid.
Some reviewers note the lashes look less natural or realistic than expected.
